::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 26th [1899]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Lord Egremont, Petworth House, in the care of West Sussex Record Office, PHA 9687/2.
:::

Dear [Lady Leconfield](people/person_1664.qmd)
As [Christabel Coleridge](people/person_329.qmd) is here, I shall ask her to put in her autograph She is the remnant of my original [Goslings](organizations/other_104.qmd) worked on as a [Spider](organizations/other_116.qmd) and now edits the [Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd), anxious to raise the tone, and bear it through the bad times for periodicals If you have read [Waynflete](other_books/otherbook_205.qmd), the [Main Chance](other_books/otherbook_206.qmd) and [The Tender Mercies](other_books/otherbook_207.qmd), you will think her autograph worth having. She is the granddaughter of [S T Coleridge](people/person_1667.qmd)

yours sincerely
C M Yonge
